description: Run a File > Automate or File > Scripts command on the active document without its dialog: crop_and_straighten (Crop and Straighten Photos: each scanned photo into its own document), fit_image (Fit Image: resize to fit a box), conditional_mode_change (Conditional Mode Change), lens_correction (Automate > Lens Correction's automatic profile correction), delete_empty_layers (Delete All Empty Layers), flatten_layer_effects (Flatten All Layer Effects), flatten_masks (Flatten All Masks)

autoScale.description: lens_correction: scale to hide blank edges. Default true

chromaticAberration.description: lens_correction: correct chromatic aberration. Default false

distortion.description: lens_correction: correct geometric distortion. Default true

dontEnlarge.description: fit_image: leave images already smaller than the box. Default false

edge.description: lens_correction: fill for edges left blank. Default transparency

flatten.description: conditional_mode_change: flatten while converting. Default false

sourceModes.description: conditional_mode_change: convert only from these modes. Default all

targetMode.description: conditional_mode_change: the mode to convert to

name: run_automate_command
title: Run Automate Command
